_comment: W Linux greeter — admin config. Not touched by w-style/w-theme. See GreeterConfig.qml for all keys.
_primaryMonitor_comment: Connector name of the monitor showing the login card (e.g. "DP-1"). Empty = auto: monitor at the layout origin (0,0), else the first screen. Wallpaper fills every monitor regardless.
_cardOpacity_comment: Opacity of the card background only (inputs stay opaque). Below 1 reveals the compositor blur. 1 = solid. Number (0..1) OR effects-axis token "surface"/"scrim" (follows the theme).
_timing_comment: Login flow choreography (ms). in: initPause → wallpaper → uiDelay → interface. out: interface → uiDelay → wallpaper → postPause → launch. bgFade/uiFade = fade durations.
_launchDelay_comment: When to start the user session: false = after the wallpaper fully fades out (seamless black hand-off). A number = ms after login is confirmed regardless of fade (0 = immediately); overlaps the user session cold start with the fade tail to cut black time.
